METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.

4. When learning Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .

5. When learning Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.

6. When learning Safety in the workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the workshop.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the workshop.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the workshop.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.

9. When learning Introduction to Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork.

10. When learning Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.

11. When learning Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Measuring and marking out tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. A — Information and Communication Technology

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the workshop.

7. A — CPU

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.

12. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
